title: Leaving a page with unsaved changes gives no warning; edits are lost
steps: Click Service Account (top bar) to open My Personnel Details
Type in Middle Name: Save Changes becomes enabled
Hover Flight Operations in the sidebar and click Dashboard
expected: Guide §3: 'The current page has unsaved changes...' modal with Cancel (stay) and Continue (leave).
actual: Dashboard opens immediately, no modal; the typed change is discarded.
cause: Dirty-state check in `main/index.js` menu click handler is not wired to Personnel Details (or not at all).

title: personneldetails/index.js is truncated: ReferenceError getPickerMod on every load
steps: Click Service Account (top bar) or open any person from All Personnel
Watch the console
expected: No console errors.
actual: `ReferenceError: getPickerMod is not defined` at `templates2/personneldetails/index.js?v=2.0.111:13734`. The file's last line is `window.getPickerMode = getPickerMod` (cut off; should be `getPickerMode;`), so `window.getPickerMode` is never set and anything after it never runs.
cause: `personneldetails/index.js` last line truncated during build/deploy; restore `window.getPickerMode = getPickerMode;` and check nothing else is missing from the end of the file.

title: Login Message popup reappears on every browser reload
steps: Log in and close the Login Message with OK
Press F5 / reload on any page
expected: Guide: Login Message is shown after login (once per login).
actual: The Login Message opens again after every reload. Guide or app?

title: Logout throws JS error removeChild; Esc doesn't close the Log Out confirm
steps: Click Logout in the top bar
Press Esc (nothing happens)
Click Log Out
expected: Esc closes the confirm (CON-015); no console errors.
actual: Esc ignored (see POP-02). On Log Out the console logs `Failed to execute 'removeChild' on 'Node': The node to be removed is not a child of this node.` Logout itself works.

title: New User accepts a 6-character password (placeholder and Change Credentials require 10)
steps: Settings and Tools > Access Manager > New User
Fill all fields, Password and Confirm = a 6-character value (e.g. 'short1')
Click Create User
expected: Rejected: 'Password must be at least 10 characters' (placeholder says 'Minimum 10 characters'; Change Credentials needs 10).
actual: Toast 'User BETA TEST ONLY Lowperm created successfully'; account created with the 6-char password.
cause: No min-length check in the New User handler (client and server) for create; only Change Credentials enforces 10.

title: Last Activity hover date ignores Settings > Time Zone format
steps: Settings > Time Zone is DD/MM/YYYY, 24-hour
Access Manager: hover the Last Activity value of Service Account ('4 mins ago')
expected: Exact date in org format, e.g. 21/10/2026 20:45 (local).
actual: Tooltip '21 Oct 2026, 07:45 am': hard-coded format, 12-hour, and shows the UTC time (07:45) rather than local (20:45).
cause: Tooltip built with toLocaleString / fixed format instead of formatDateWithConfig; timestamp not converted to org time zone.

title: Last Activity column sort does not change order
steps: Access Manager > User Permissions
Click the Last Activity header, then click it again
expected: Ascending then descending: Service Account (only user with activity) moves from top to bottom.
actual: Same order both times: Service Account, Alex Richards, Zoe Mason, Curtis Porter... User and Username sort correctly.
cause: Sort comparator for Last Activity ignores direction (or sorts on the relative text with 'Never' handled separately).

title: Error modal ('Failed to Create User') does not close with Esc
steps: Access Manager > New User
Username 'root', fill the rest, Create User
Error modal 'Failed to Create User - That username is not allowed' opens; press Esc
expected: Esc closes it (as Help does on the same page).
actual: Modal stays open; only OK closes it. Same as the logout confirm (BUG-LOG-002).
cause: #errorModal has no keydown Escape handler.

title: Sidebar lists modules the user has no permission for (all lead to Access Denied)
steps: Access Manager: create user, give 0 roles / 0 permissions, set credentials, Activate
Log in as that user
Open the sidebar and click each item
expected: Only modules the user can open are listed (Roster Builder, Timesheets etc. are already hidden, so filtering exists).
actual: 17 items listed (Dashboard, Flight Schedule, Active Flights, DFR, Roster Viewer, All Personnel, Flight and Duty, Notices, Recency and Renewals, Safety Reports, Hazard Register, Settings and Tools, File Browser, Form Browser, Task Tracker, Reports, Support); every one shows 'Access Denied'. The landing page (Dashboard) is also Access Denied.
cause: Sidebar build in main/index.pl does not check the permission types used by each module's own access check. Note: checklist NAV-019 (from the user guide) expects the link to stay visible and show Access Denied, so this may be by design - needs a product decision.

title: User with no permissions cannot open their own My Account (no self-service password / 2FA)
steps: Log in as a user with 0 permissions (BETA TEST ONLY Lowperm)
Click your name in the top bar
expected: Own My Account opens (at least Security and Customize tabs) so the user can change password and set up 2FA.
actual: 'Access Denied: You do not have permission to access the Personnel Details' for person_id=276 (own record).
cause: Personnel Details access check does not allow self (person_id == logged-in person) when no Personnel permission row exists.

title: Permission level dropdown shows bare codes 'WA' and 'G' next to full labels
steps: Access Manager > a user's 'N Permissions' badge
Look at the level dropdown for Personnel Details (also Flight Schedule, Dashboard, DFR)
expected: Every level has a readable label, e.g. 'Read/Write All - Can view and modify all data', 'Group - level defined by group membership' (as in the Help).
actual: Options: 'Read Only All - ...', 'WA', 'Read Only Own - ...', 'Write Own - ...', 'G'.
cause: Label map in accessmanager JS is missing WA and G (falls back to the code).

title: Manage User Permissions uses a native browser confirm() for unsaved changes
steps: Access Manager > a user's 'N Permissions' badge
Tick any permission type
Click Cancel
expected: App-styled confirm modal (like Activate Login Access / Logout), Esc = stay.
actual: Native Chrome confirm: 'You have unsaved changes. Are you sure you want to cancel?'. Looks out of place, cannot be styled, blocks the page.

title: 'Performance' debug timing panel shown on every page, including to non-admin users

Open My Account or Access Manager
expected: Debug timing panel hidden for normal users (only when debug is switched on for an admin), or at least off by default.

title: Personnel Details modals (Enable 2FA, Setup Error alert): title right-aligned, away from its icon
steps: My Account > Security
Click Enable 2FA
expected: Header like other modals: icon then title, left-aligned (e.g. 'Activate Login Access').
actual: Lock icon on the far left, 'Enable 2FA' title pushed to the far right of the header. Same on the shared #alert-modal ('Setup Error / Invalid password').
cause: Header uses justify-content: space-between without the title wrapper used by other modals.

title: 2FA setup: one wrong verification code closes the setup dialog and issues a new secret
steps: My Account > Security > Enable 2FA, enter password, Confirm
Scan the QR code / note the key
Enter a wrong 6-digit code, click Verify and Enable
Click OK on '2FA Setup Failed - Error: Invalid verification code'

actual: Setup dialog closes. Clicking Enable 2FA again generates a new key and new backup codes, so the entry already added to the authenticator app is useless and must be deleted and re-scanned.
cause: Verify failure handler closes #2fa-setup-modal and discards the pending secret.

title: Security tab 'Enabled on' date ignores Settings > Time Zone format
steps: Settings > Time Zone is DD/MM/YYYY, 24-hour HH:mm
Enable 2FA on an account, view My Account > Security

title: 'Trust this device for 30 days' is lost on Logout (logout deletes the trusted-device cookie)
steps: Log in as a 2FA user, tick 'Trust this device for 30 days', enter a valid code
Check cookies: dhkey_trusted_<user> set, expires in 29-30 days
Click Logout > Log Out
Log in again with username + password
expected: 2FA page skipped on this browser for 30 days.
actual: Logout deletes all cookies (dhkey_<user>, dhkey_trusted_<user>, dhkey_username); the next login asks for the 2FA code again. Trust only survives if the user never logs out.

title: Access Manager Groups popup: Esc closes with unsaved changes and no warning; reopening shows the unsaved ticks as if saved
steps: Settings and Tools > Access Manager, search betatest_low
Click the '0 Groups' badge
Tick 'Crew' (On Roster auto-ticks)
Press Esc

Click the Groups badge again

cause: Groups modal has no dirty check on Esc/close and doesn't reset its checkbox state from the server data when reopened.

title: Dashboard side tabs are icon-only with no tooltip or label
steps: Open Dashboard from the sidebar
Hover each of the 6 tabs above the right-hand panel
expected: Each tab has a tooltip/label (Recency and Renewals, Unread Notices, Unsigned Timesheets, Safety Actions, Exams, Project Tasks).
actual: Tabs show only Material icons (update, notifications, assignment_late, assignment, quiz, checklist); no title, aria-label or tooltip. Users must click each to find out what it is; screen readers read the icon ligature names.

Recency and Renewals tab (first tab) is shown

title: Flight Schedule popups (View Details, Double Booking alert, note modals) do not close with Esc
steps: Flight Schedule (week view), click a flight to select it
Click its note / View Details icon
Press Esc

title: New flight defaults to the current UTC time instead of local time (SAR TIME labelled LOCAL shows UTC+1h)
steps: Settings > Time Zone is Pacific/Auckland (header shows UTC 08:25, Local 21:25)
Flight Schedule > Enable Live Edit > Add Flight
Look at Start Time, End Time and SAR TIME (LOCAL)
expected: Start defaults to local now (21:25), end +1h (22:25), SAR time in local time.
actual: Start 21/10/2026 08:25, End 09:25, SAR TIME (LOCAL) 09:25 - all UTC values. Near midnight the date would also be wrong. Also Cancel with no changes does nothing (only the back arrow leaves).

title: Esc does not end copy/paste mode on the Flight Schedule - the next click + Ctrl+V creates another flight
steps: Flight Schedule > Enable Live Edit
Select a flight, Ctrl+C, click an empty slot, Ctrl+V, Paste
Toast: '... press Escape to finish.' Press Esc

expected: Esc ends paste mode; Ctrl+V afterwards does nothing.
actual: No feedback on Esc; the click shows 'Press Ctrl+V to paste the flight here' and Ctrl+V creates another flight (created #42906). Users can create unwanted live flights.
cause: Escape keydown handler does not clear the copied-flight clipboard state (or is not bound inside the schedule iframe).

title: Flight Schedule header overlaps when Live Edit is on - title covered, location pill cut off and its 'Show All' button cannot be clicked
steps: Flight Schedule at 1568 px wide
Pick a location in Locations (pill 'Viewing location: Auckland Base')
Go to a past week and click Enable Live Edit

title: Planner Add Location replaces the New Booking popup - typed booking and location input is lost
steps: Flight Schedule > Planner Only > Rows by Location > Enable Live Edit
Drag across empty days in a location row > New Booking opens; type a note
Click 'Add Location' in New Booking
Leave Name and Code empty, click Save, then OK on the Error popup
expected: Add Location opens on top of New Booking; after the error you are back in Add Location with your input; after saving you return to New Booking with the new location selected and your note kept.
actual: Add Location replaces New Booking (the note is gone). OK on 'Name and Code are required.' closes all popups, so the user has to start again. After a successful Save ('Location created') New Booking does not come back either.
cause: Planner popups use one shared modal slot: opening a modal closes the current one and closing the error closes everything instead of returning to the parent modal.

title: JS error on every Live Edit toggle: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'scrollTop')
steps: Flight Schedule (Planner Only or Schedule view), DevTools console open
Click Enable Live Edit
Click Disable Live Edit
expected: No console errors.
actual: Each click logs uncaught TypeError "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'scrollTop')". The toggle still works, but later code in the same handler does not run.
cause: Edit-mode toggle handler saves/restores the scroll position of an element that does not exist in the current view mode (e.g. the time-grid scroller while the planner is shown); needs a null check.

title: Flight Schedule month view is slow: flightschedule_json takes ~1.6 s and rendering 2,500 events ~4.5 s
steps: Flight Schedule > Schedule Only
Click Month (October 2026, range 28/09-08/11)
Measure in DevTools Network: index.pl?action=flightschedule_json&start=2026-09-28&end=2026-11-09
expected: Server response < 500 ms; month view usable in about 1-2 s.
actual: Request 1,590 ms (first byte 844 ms); 2,493 events take 4.5 s from click to render. Page freezes while rendering.
cause: Whole 6-week range returned with full event details in one JSON call and every event rendered; consider a summary per day for month view, indexes on flight start/end, or lazy loading of 'more' events.

title: Edit-mode idle timeout switches Live Edit off silently, throws 'calendarEl is not defined' and leaves the schedule blank
steps: Flight Schedule > Planner Only (or any view) > Enable Live Edit
Do not touch the page for 20 minutes
expected: Edit mode turns off with the message 'Edit mode has been disabled due to inactivity.'
actual: At 20 min the button silently returns to 'Enable Live Edit'; no popup or toast, and the console shows uncaught ReferenceError 'calendarEl is not defined', so the rest of the timeout handler (probably the message and the calendar refresh) does not run. A user who comes back can think they are still editing. Afterwards the schedule is left blank (month view 'October 2026' with no flights) until the page is reloaded.
cause: Inactivity handler references a variable calendarEl that is not in scope (renamed or local to another function).

title: Flight Details Save Changes does not return to the Flight Schedule and gives no success message
steps: Flight Schedule > Schedule Only > week
Double-click flight #42903 > Flight Details
Add a passenger or comment
Click Save Changes
expected: Flight is saved and you return to where you came from (the Flight Schedule week you were on), as described in the guide.
actual: The page reloads in place (URL now has return_url=/index.pl?action=flightschedule) and stays on Flight Details. No toast or message says it was saved; only the greyed-out Save Changes button hints at it. The user has to click Back.
cause: Save handler reloads the details page with return_url instead of navigating to return_url after a successful save.

title: Flight Details History misses edits saved in Flight Details and shows a false 'Aircraft: ZK-SIM > Unassigned' on schedule moves
steps: Flight Schedule > Enable Live Edit > move/resize flight #42903 (ZK-SIM)
Double-click it > Flight Details > add a custom passenger and a comment > Save Changes
Click History
expected: History shows every change including the Flight Details save (passenger added, comment added), and only fields that really changed.
actual: The Flight Details save at 10:17 pm is not listed; newest entry is the 09:31 pm schedule move. Each schedule move/resize entry lists 'Aircraft: ZK-SIM > Unassigned' (the aircraft stayed ZK-SIM) and 'Source: (blank) > Flight Schedule'. Values are shown as raw '2026-10-21 09:30:00' instead of DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM.
cause: Schedule drag/resize audit compares against a payload without aircraft (null > 'Unassigned'); Flight Details save path either does not write to the audit log or only logs main-table fields (passengers/comments not tracked).

title: Times and Meters: no link to the previous flight next to 'Previous' meter readings
steps: Open flight #42903 (ZK-SIM) > Times and Weights
Look at Meters (Engine Hours, Flight Hours)
expected: Each meter shows the previous reading and a link to the flight it came from (guide).
actual: 'Previous: 2450.3 (+0.0)' is shown but there is no link; the only link in the panel is an info icon (href '#'). The user cannot check which flight set the previous reading.

title: Leg PIC / Secondary Flight Crew dropdowns offer passengers (e.g. a custom passenger can be chosen as leg PIC)
steps: Open flight #42903 > Passenger List > Add Custom Passenger 'BETA TEST ONLY Pax'
Times and Weights > Add Leg
Open the leg PIC or Secondary Flight Crew dropdown

actual: Leg PIC and Secondary Flight Crew list 'BETA TEST ONLY Lowperm' and 'BETA TEST ONLY Pax' - the custom passenger can be picked as the leg's pilot, which would put a passenger's hours into crew/FRMS records.
cause: Leg crew dropdowns are filled from the whole manifest (crew + passengers) instead of crew only.

title: Leg with two unknown waypoints: only the first is offered for adding, the second is silently dropped on save
steps: Open flight #42903 > Times and Weights > Add Leg
Departure 'ZZZQ', Destination 'NZWN' (neither in Settings > Waypoints)
Save Changes > 'Add New Waypoint' for ZZZQ > Add Waypoint
Back, reopen the flight > Times and Weights
expected: You are asked about each unknown waypoint (ZZZQ, then NZWN) before the flight is saved; nothing you typed is lost.
actual: Only ZZZQ is prompted ('Waypoint "ZZZQ" added successfully'), then the flight saves straight away and the leg Destination is stored empty - NZWN is lost without a warning. Typing NZWN again and saving does prompt for it.
cause: After 'Add Waypoint' the save continues without re-validating the remaining unknown waypoints, and unknown codes are blanked instead of blocking the save.

title: Active Flights shows SAR Time '01/01/1970 00:00' for flights with SAR watch disabled
steps: Sidebar > Flight Operations > Active Flights
Look at the SAR Time column for PAST flights (e.g. #8861, #8844)
expected: Flights without SAR watch show a dash or just 'SAR Watch Disabled' in the SAR Time column.
actual: SAR Time shows '01/01/1970 00:00' above 'SAR Watch Disabled' (Unix epoch shown for an empty SAR time).
cause: Empty/0 SAR timestamp formatted as a date instead of being treated as no value.

title: Active Flights lists future flights that have no SAR time, and the stats cards don't count them
steps: Sidebar > Flight Operations > Active Flights
Look at the status column and the stats cards
expected: Only open flights whose start or SAR time has passed are listed, and Total = Active + Past + Overdue.
actual: 6 FUTURE flights (#8853, #8854, #8855, #8857, #8858, #8860) are listed with Active Time 00h 00m and SAR Time '01/01/1970 00:00 NO SAR TIME SET'. Cards show Total 1377, Active 0, Past 1364, Overdue 7, so the 6 future flights are in Total but in no other card.
cause: An empty SAR time is stored/treated as 0 (1970), which counts as 'passed', so future flights pass the list filter.

title: Active Flights has no page Help (?), and its popups (About Live Tracking, Adjust SAR, Add Note) don't close with Escape
steps: Sidebar > Flight Operations > Active Flights
Look for the Help (?) button in the page header
Click the help icon in the Live Tracking box ('About Live Tracking')
Press Escape; look for an x button
Click Adjust SAR or Add Note on an OVERDUE row, press Escape
expected: Like other modules, a page Help (?) button that opens help; every help popup closes with Got it, x, clicking outside and Escape.
actual: No page-level Help (?) button exists (the only help is 'About Live Tracking'). That popup has only 'Got it', no x, and Escape does not close it. Adjust SAR and Add Note popups also stay open on Escape (Add Note with typed text and no prompt). Got it / Cancel and clicking outside do close them.

title: Active Flights overdue and active times are 13 h out: local SAR/start times are compared with UTC 'now'
steps: Open flight #42903 (Start 21/10/2026 08:30, SAR TIME (LOCAL) 21/10/2026 09:30 in Flight Details) and set Flight Status to Open, Save
At 22:33 local / 09:33 UTC open Sidebar > Flight Operations > Active Flights
Look at row #42903
expected: SAR 09:30 local passed 13 hours ago: 'OVERDUE by 13h 03m', Active Time 14h 03m.
actual: Row shows SAR '21/10/2026 09:30 OVERDUE by 3m' and Active Time '01h 03m' - the countdown uses UTC now (09:33) against the local time, so an overdue flight looks only just overdue for 13 hours. For a search-and-rescue watch this delays the alarm. Confirmed with Adjust SAR: setting SAR to 21/10/2026 23:30 at 22:34 local shows '13h 55m remaining' instead of about 56m.
cause: Active Flights compares the stored local SAR/start time with the UTC clock (or Flight Details labels UTC times as local). Related to BUG-FS-001 (Add Flight defaults to UTC).

title: Daily Flight Record has no page Help (?), and its popups (Manage Columns, Notes full text) don't close with Escape
steps: Sidebar > Flight Operations > Daily Flight Record
Look for the Help (?) button in the page header
Click Columns (Manage Columns popup), press Escape
Click a Notes cell (Notes full-text popup), press Escape
expected: A page Help (?) button like other modules; the Manage Columns popup closes with x, clicking outside and Escape.
actual: There is no Help (?) button on the page. Manage Columns closes with x, Done and clicking outside, and stays open on drag-out (correct), but Escape does nothing. The Notes full-text popup also stays open on Escape.
cause: No help content or button wired for this module; the column modal has no keydown Escape handler.

title: Daily Flight Record: Clear Filters unticks every status (lists Open, Cancelled and Deleted flights), and the date fields show today's date when no date filter is applied
steps: Sidebar > Flight Operations > Daily Flight Record
Expand Advanced Filters: Completed and Complete Locked are ticked, Date From/To both show 21/10/2026 (today) but the list has flights from other days
Type Rego ZK-SIM (or any filter), press Enter
Click Clear Filters
expected: Clear Filters goes back to the default view: Completed + Complete Locked, no other filters. Empty date filters show empty fields (or the dates shown are actually applied).
actual: Clear Filters unticks all five status pills, so the list shows every status, including Open and Deleted flights (e.g. #9476 Open, #42902 Deleted), and the filter badge disappears. The Date From/To fields show today's date on load and after clearing, yet no date filter is applied.
cause: Clear resets status checkboxes to unchecked instead of the defaults, and an empty status set is treated as 'all'. The date pickers display a default value that is not sent as a filter.

title: Daily Flight Record: changing filters quickly appends results instead of replacing them, showing duplicate and wrong-status rows
steps: Sidebar > Flight Operations > Daily Flight Record > expand Advanced Filters
Click the Open status pill twice quickly (on, then off)
Look at the list: only Completed + Complete Locked are ticked
Or: with only Cancelled ticked, quickly click Completed, Complete Locked and Cancelled to get back to the defaults
expected: The list always matches the current filters, each flight once (30 Completed rows).
actual: Open on/off quickly: 60 rows, 30 Open flights plus 30 Completed, although Open is unticked. Three quick clicks back to the defaults: 90 rows of which 60 are duplicate IDs. Changing one filter at a time (4 s apart) is correct. Seen earlier too: Flight ID 42903 listed twice followed by unfiltered flights.
cause: Each filter change starts a new load, and every response is appended to the table; earlier, slower requests are not cancelled or ignored, and the table is not cleared per request.

title: All Personnel has no page Help (?)
steps: Sidebar > Personnel > All Personnel
Look for the Help (?) button in the page header
expected: A Help (?) button that opens help for the page, as on Personnel Details and Flight Details.
actual: The page has only the search box and the group/role filters. There is no Help (?) button.

Look at the first row (or set All Roles > Customer)
Click it

title: Personnel Details: History, PDF Options and Legacy Duty Browser popups don't close with Escape, and PDF Options has no x

Timesheets tab > Legacy Duty Browser, press Escape

title: Personnel Details > Recency and Renewals: action buttons are hidden (Add Item, Table/Card view, renewal Save / Complete Renewal / Cancel) and Group by / Order by are disabled
steps: All Personnel > Ethan Abbott > Recency and Renewals tab
Try to change Group by to Status, or Order by to Expiry Date
Look for the Table / Card view buttons

expected: Add Item opens the add renewal/recency search; Group by and Order by change the list; Table and Card buttons switch the layout.

title: Personnel Details > Recency: 'Days Until Expiry' and status don't match the Last Conducted date
steps: All Personnel > Ethan Abbott > Recency and Renewals tab
Look at the Pilot Licenses Recencies rows (today 21/10/2026)
expected: Days match the dates, e.g. Day Landings last conducted 03/02/2026 with a 90-day window expired about 170 days ago (260 days since last conducted), and an expired item shows Expired.
actual: Day Landings: Last Conducted 03/02/2026, '462 days ago', status Caution, count 0/0 in 90 days. Instrument Approaches: 26/07/2025, '447 days ago', Caution, 0/0 in 180 days. title: Changing Schedule Start Time saves a full date-time, and the setting then shows NaN:NaN
steps: Settings and Tools > Operations > Flight Schedule.
In Schedule Start Time, type 06:00 and press Tab.
Click Update Changes ("Settings updated successfully").
Reload the page.
expected: Start time is saved as 06:00 and still shows 06:00 after reload.
actual: The page saves the picker's full value ("2026-10-22 06:00:00"). On reload it splits that on ":" to get the hours, gets NaN, and the box shows "NaN:NaN". The server then stores "NaN-NaN-NaN NaN:NaN:NaN". After that, typing a new time does not enable Update Changes, so a user can't fix it from the UI.
cause: templates2/settings_flightschedule/index.js: the change listener does state.scheduleStartTime = e.target.value, but datetimepicker.js writes "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" to .dtp-hidden-input. init then does state.scheduleStartTime.split(":").map(Number). Fix: keep only HH:MM (e.g. value.slice(11,16)) and check it is valid before saving.
